system.description:
You're a walking mess of scars. Although you heal damage with Cainite efficiency, the regenerating flesh returns as scar tissue every time — Vicissitude doesn't help, and in fact aggravates the condition with stretch marks and cicatrices anywhere your skin breaks. This doesn't hamper you physically at its base level, but it does affect your interactions with other people.

At 2 points, all Social roll difficulties increase by one (in MET terms, you suffer the negative Social Traits Scarface x2, which must be worn open and notoriously displayed, on a badge or similar marker). At 3 points, your face and body are so horribly blemished that your Appearance rating can never exceed 2 (MET: your Social Traits may never exceed five), in addition to the lesser penalty. At 4 points, the scar tissue is thick enough to hinder movement: all Dexterity roll difficulties also increase by one (MET: a further one-Trait penalty to all Physical Challenges), on top of the lower tiers' penalties. In the tabletop system, you can ignore the Dexterity penalty for one specific action by taking one level of unsoakable bashing damage, tearing the scar tissue for greater range of motion; the penalty returns once that damage heals.
system.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
